_about: Starting values for how risks are rated (15 Nov 2026). These are the starting values. Tech Risk changes them on the site (Edit, Rating settings), and a saved change wins over this file. What was picked and why: docs/design/19_risk_rating.md.
_medium_share_above: A risk that is not Critical or High is Medium when more than this share of its likelihood drivers is on. 0.30 means one driver of three.
_elevated: A risk is Elevated when its likelihood AND its impact are both at or above these levels (proposed; to confirm with the Head of Tech Risk).
_rate_with_current_rules: A switch (owner, 17 Nov 2026). true: every results page rates each team's newest answers again with today's risks, drivers, questions, rating settings and data, so a change shows without every team submitting again. false: pages show the result kept when the team submitted. Nothing kept is ever changed. Meant for now, until more history has built up.
_how_to: To turn it off, change true to false here, or set it to No on the Risk site at Edit, Rating settings.
_pervasive_categories: A driver is pervasive when it reaches at least this many risk categories. Used on the team results pages (owner, 17 Nov 2026).
